bools.comment: the nature - the oni are fearsome spirits who dwell in desolate and forbidding places (print capture p. 280)

bools.comment: the skin - normally red, but other colors including green, black, orange, and purple have been seen (print capture p. 280)

bools.comment: the blue skins - there are also blue-skinned oni, although these are more commonly known as ogre magi (print capture p. 280)

bools.comment: the dress - imitates that of the local human population, although more ragged and dirty than their human counterparts (print capture p. 280)

bools.name: dkpCommonHaunts
bools.comment: the common haunts - found living in rocky mountain regions, deserted ruins, graveyards, and other sites commonly considered haunted (print capture p. 280)

bools.name: dkpHighwayShrineTerror
bools.comment: the highway clause - occasionally they take up residence along a lonely highway at a shrine or gate, terrorizing all who go by (print capture p. 280)

bools.name: dkpBloodthirstyCruel
bools.comment: the temper - bloodthirsty and cruel, attacking for food and the sheer delight of cruelty (print capture p. 280)

bools.name: dkpTwoHandedSwordOrClaws
bools.comment: the common weapons - they commonly fight with two-handed swords wielded in one hand or their powerful claws (print capture p. 280)

bools.name: dkpCauseFearAtWill
bools.comment: the fear power - cause fear at will (print capture p. 280)

bools.name: dkpCommandsLesserCreatures
bools.comment: the command - frequently found in command of lesser creatures such as bakemono, goblin rats, and gaki (print capture p. 280)

bools.name: dkpLairCourt
bools.comment: the lair court - encountered in their lair there are always 4d10 bakemono or goblin rats present, attending the court of the more powerful oni (print capture p. 281)

bools.name: dkpCommonSpeaksFive
bools.comment: the common languages - able to speak the language of their kind and the languages of tengu, bakemono, hengeyokai, and the local human population (print capture p. 281)

bools.name: dkpGoZuBullHeads
bools.comment: the go-zu heads - stand eight to nine feet tall with a hulking body and the heads of bulls (print capture p. 281)

bools.name: dkpGoZuCelestialSoldiers
bools.comment: the go-zu standing - unlike the common oni, servants and soldiers of the Celestial Empire (print capture p. 281)

bools.name: dkpGoZuMeZuEmperorsArmy
bools.comment: the army clause - the go-zu and the me-zu form the bulk of the Celestial Emperor army in times of trouble and insurrection (print capture p. 281)

bools.name: dkpGoZuOverseeLandsOfDead
bools.comment: the dead lands - they also oversee the lands of the dead and escort the reluctant departed there (print capture p. 281)

bools.name: dkpGoZuSoldierDress
bools.comment: the go-zu dress - they dress in armor and robes appropriate to their position as soldiers of the Celestial Emperor (print capture p. 281)

bools.name: dkpGoZuWeaponRoster
bools.comment: the go-zu weapons - they fight with two-handed swords, spears, naginata, halberds, and tridents (print capture p. 281)

bools.name: dkpGoZuTwoAttacksAndGore
bools.comment: the go-zu combat - able to make two attacks with a weapon or their hands per round and gore with their horns (print capture p. 281)

bools.name: dkpGoZuAtWillPowers
bools.comment: the go-zu at-will powers - polymorph self, cause fear, become invisible, fly, and cast fire shuriken (print capture p. 281)

bools.name: dkpGoZuCloudTrapezeTwicePerDay
bools.comment: the go-zu cloud trapeze - twice per day (print capture p. 281)

bools.name: dkpGoZuAutoDetectInvisible
bools.comment: the go-zu detection - they can automatically detect invisible creatures and objects (print capture p. 281)

bools.name: dkpGoZuHillGiantStrength
bools.comment: the go-zu strength - equal to that of a hill giant (print capture p. 281)

bools.name: dkpGoZuLanguages
bools.comment: the go-zu languages - all human languages and those of tengu, oni, bakemono, animals, and the Celestial Court (print capture p. 281)

bools.name: dkpMeZuMostImportant
bools.comment: the me-zu standing - the most important of all oni (print capture p. 281)

bools.name: dkpMeZuHorseHeads
bools.comment: the me-zu look - ogre sized with the heads of horses (print capture p. 281)

bools.name: dkpMeZuHigherRank
bools.comment: the me-zu rank - like the go-zu, servants and soldiers of the Celestial Emperor, although generally holding positions of higher rank within his army (print capture p. 281)

bools.name: dkpMeZuWhipsAndLassos
bools.comment: the me-zu extra tools - in addition to the weapons used by the go-zu oni, they are also known to use whips and lassos to deal with their victims (print capture p. 281)

bools.name: dkpMeZuAtWillPowers
bools.comment: the me-zu at-will powers - polymorph self, become invisible, cause fear, and fly (print capture p. 281)

bools.name: dkpMeZuEtherealAstralTwicePerDay
bools.comment: the me-zu plane shifts - become ethereal or astral two times per day (print capture p. 281)

bools.name: dkpMeZuCloudTrapezeThricePerDay
bools.comment: the me-zu cloud trapeze - three times per day (print capture p. 281)

bools.name: dkpMeZuWuJenSpellcasting
bools.comment: the me-zu spellcasting - the spell casting ability of a wu jen of the same experience level as their hit dice (print capture p. 281)

bools.name: dkpMeZuTrueSeeingAlways
bools.comment: the me-zu sight - the sight abilities as per the true seeing spell in effect at all times (print capture p. 281)

bools.name: dkpMeZuAnyLanguage
bools.comment: the me-zu languages - able to speak and understand any language (print capture p. 281)

bools.name: dkpMeZuStoneGiantStrength
bools.comment: the me-zu strength - equal to that of a stone giant (print capture p. 281)

bools.name: dkpMeZuOnCelestialMission
bools.comment: the me-zu errand - when encountered they are on some mission assigned by the Celestial Empire and do not brook any interference or delay to this mission (print capture p. 281)
